Flurry.note: Proc chain: melee crit → Flurry → more swings → more Windfury and Maelstrom Weapon procs.

mods.fx: more crits after a spell crit

Elemental Devastation.note: Proc chain: spell crit → melee crit for 10 sec → more Flurry. A hybrid enhancement talent.

Lightning Overload.note: Free half-damage copies of Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning; anything that makes those stronger counts twice.

Maelstrom Weapon.note: Proc chain: melee hits → faster, cheaper Lightning Bolt. More swings (Flurry, Windfury) mean more stacks.

Improved Stormstrike.note: Resource loop: Stormstrike lets mana regen continue while casting; dodges and parries can reset it.

Thundering Strikes.note: More crits feed Flurry and Elemental Devastation.

Mental Dexterity.note: Turns Intellect into Attack Power: Intellect gear helps an enhancement shaman twice.

Riptide.note: Combo: Riptide the target first, then Chain Heal it.

Water Shield.note: Resource loop: getting hit and spell crits restore mana.

Restorative Totems.note: Stronger Mana Spring and Healing Stream totems.
